01 / FEATURED CASE STUDYExplore live prototype ↗

A calm aesthetic.
A complete experience.

NOMAÉ

I created a minimalist fashion store from the ground up, designing every screen in Figma before using Codex to implement and refine a live prototype.

MY ROLE

UI design, shopping flows, visual system, implementation with Codex, GitHub and Vercel publication.

THE CHALLENGE

Make every next step clear.

Carry an editorial visual direction through discovery, product evaluation, size selection, bag review and checkout, while keeping practical shopping information close to each decision.

THE DESIGN RESPONSE

Design beyond the homepage.

A connected catalog, product pages, wishlist, bag, staged checkout, account screens and support routes. Reusable components and explicit selection states keep the experience coherent.

Discover→Evaluate→Choose→Review→Checkout
REVIEW & REFINEMENT

Small changes at key decisions.

I redirected the general shopping CTA to the catalog, added an expandable size guide with unit switching, and paired delivery costs with illustrative arrival ranges.

OUTCOME & REFLECTION

From Figma to a live prototype.

The desktop demo flow was reviewed through confirmation. This independent concept uses simulated checkout; no participant research or conversion measurement was conducted. Accessibility testing and deeper error recovery are next steps.
